pass_gate: A positive control produces at least two callback increments; A gets the transfer initiating press; while B is focused and global W remains down, each B W KeyPress links to one unique counter increment with before/after +1, B focus, and 32-byte keymap W-down evidence.
fail_gate: Well-formed positive control but no B callback effect during the held transfer interval.
stop_gate: Missing positive control, bad source/image identity, missing event/effect linkage, audit error, or incomplete Xvfb cleanup.
scope: synthetic private Xvfb/XTEST client counter only; no actual app, game, MAP01, safety or efficacy claim
